name: Peppergrass

facts.how: Raw as a peppery green and seasoning

caution: A safe mustard-family plant; confirm the peppery taste and the tiny round flat pods. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A wiry weed hung with hundreds of tiny round flat green pods up the stem. Chew a leaf or pod: sharp black pepper and cress.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: The green pods are a wild pepper and caper both; scatter the leaves and pods into salads for free heat.
